highlights.title_zh: 开源 LLM 能读脑电吗？严谨阴性结果：直接解码在随机水平，给它经典解码器才有用
highlights.title_en: Can an Open LLM Read EEG? A Rigorous Negative Result: Chance Alone, Useful Only With a Decoder Tool
highlights.brief: 一个难得**敢报阴性结果**的实验：问「开源大模型能否仅凭 4 秒头皮脑电判断想象握左拳还是右拳」，且严格要求**被试独立**（模型没见过测试者），统一 144 个留出试次 + 两项统计检验。结论很干脆：**LLM 读不了脑电本身**——原版 `glm-5p3-flash` 52.8%、LoRA 微调 51.4%，都在随机水平，且约 80% 的试次都答「左」；换更强的 Claude Fable 5.1 也只 54.2%（p=0.18）。**真正有用的是架构**：把 CSP+LDA 解码器封装成工具让它调用，同一模型升到 62.5%（p=0.002），而解码器单独 63.2%——**LLM 提供的是控制层而非精度**，代价约 0.6 秒/次决策。对当前「LLM 直接解码 EEG」的叙事，这是最需要的一剂证据。

highlights.title_zh: EEGDash 一批 ingest 修复：CTF 残半试次、latin-1 重试与通道名不一致
highlights.title_en: EEGDash Ingestion Fixes: CTF Partial Trials, latin-1 Retry and Channel-Name Mismatches
highlights.brief: EEGDash 在 11-03 推进 9 次提交，几乎都是「格式不规范也要读对」：#516 对**最后一个 trial 只写了一半的 meg4**只读取完整 trial（残段当有效数据会让该被试的所有指标偏一点）；#517 与 #520 在 **sidecar 记录数与文件头不一致**时正确取到通道名（iEEG、BrainVision/EEGLAB）；#518 让 `.set` digest 解析器在非 UTF-8 时用 **latin-1 重试**，并排除已知问题数据集 ds005787。同批还有 Corpus tab 的 v0 文档（#519）。对做大规模入库的团队，这些修复的价值不在「多支持了某个格式」，而在**避免静默错位**——错一列通道名，后面所有空间分析都会跟着错。

highlights.title_zh: EEGEdu 修 256 Hz 滤波采样率、SSVEP/ERP 时序与 BLE 内存泄漏
highlights.title_en: EEGEdu Fixes the 256 Hz Filter Rate, SSVEP/ERP Timing and BLE Memory Leaks
highlights.brief: EEGEdu（浏览器里的交互式脑电教学/实验平台）在 11-03 连推 3 个提交，修的都是「看起来能跑但结果不对」的问题：**256 Hz 滤波的 `samplingRate` 传错**（频率轴整体偏移，SSVEP 目标频率会落到错误位置）、滑块状态闭包、以及 **SSVEP/ERP 刺激时序**。另两条更偏工程：**ConnectableObservable 内存泄漏**、**BLE 断连处理**与 KNN 识别逻辑——浏览器里「BLE 流 + 实时渲染」的组合最容易积累这类隐患，表现为跑十几分钟后越来越卡。对用网页做课堂演示或轻量实验的团队，这类修复直接决定演示是否可信；建议升级后对照已知 SSVEP 频率验证一次。

items.title_zh: 开源 LLM 能读脑电吗？严谨阴性结果：直接解码在随机水平，给它经典解码器才有用
items.title_en: Can an Open LLM Read EEG? A Rigorous Negative Result: Chance Alone, Useful Only With a Decoder Tool
bullets_zh: 设定：仅凭 **4 秒头皮脑电**判断「想象握左拳还是右拳」，且**被试独立**（模型从未见过测试者），统一在 **144 个留出试次**上评测并做两项统计检验。
结果：原版 `glm-5p3-flash` **52.8%**、LoRA 微调 **51.4%**——均在随机水平，且约 80% 的试次都答「左」；换更强的 Claude Fable 5.1 零样本也只有 **54.2%**（p=0.18）。
但把 **CSP+LDA 解码器封装成工具**给它调用，同一模型升到 **62.5%**（p=0.002），而解码器单独是 **63.2%**（p=0.001）——**LLM 提供的是控制层，不是解码精度**，每次决策约 0.6 秒。
bullets_en: Setup: decide from 4 s of scalp EEG whether someone imagined squeezing the left or right fist, person-independent (the model never saw test participants), scored on the same 144 held-out trials with two statistical tests.
Results: stock glm-5p3-flash scores 52.8% and a LoRA fine-tune 51.4% — both at chance, both answering LEFT about 80% of the time; Claude Fable 5.1 zero-shot reaches only 54.2% (p=0.18).
Wrapping a CSP+LDA decoder as a tool lifts the same model to 62.5% (p=0.002) against 63.2% for the decoder alone — the LLM contributes control, not decoding accuracy, at ~0.6 s per decision.
items.brief: 一个难得**敢报阴性结果**的实验：问「开源大模型能否仅凭 4 秒头皮脑电判断想象握左拳还是右拳」，且严格要求**被试独立**（模型没见过测试者），统一 144 个留出试次 + 两项统计检验。结论很干脆：**LLM 读不了脑电本身**——原版 `glm-5p3-flash` 52.8%、LoRA 微调 51.4%，都在随机水平，且约 80% 的试次都答「左」；换更强的 Claude Fable 5.1 也只 54.2%（p=0.18）。**真正有用的是架构**：把 CSP+LDA 解码器封装成工具让它调用，同一模型升到 62.5%（p=0.002），而解码器单独 63.2%——**LLM 提供的是控制层而非精度**，代价约 0.6 秒/次决策。对当前「LLM 直接解码 EEG」的叙事，这是最需要的一剂证据。
items.brief_en: A rare honest negative result: can an open LLM tell from 4 s of scalp EEG whether someone imagined a left or right fist squeeze, person-independent, on 144 held-out trials with two statistical tests? It cannot — stock 52.8% and LoRA 51.4% at chance, answering LEFT ~80% of the time, Claude Fable 5.1 only 54.2%. Giving it CSP+LDA as a tool reaches 62.5% versus 63.2% alone: control, not accuracy.
items.raw_excerpt: README: "We asked whether an open LLM can tell, from 4 seconds of scalp EEG, whether a person imagined squeezing their left or right fist. We tested the person-independent case… scored on the same 144 held-out trials and checked with two statistical tests." "**Headline:** the LLM cannot read the brain signal itself. Stock `glm-5p3-flash` scores **52.8%** and the LoRA fine-tune **51.4%**… Claude Fable 5.1, zero-shot, scores **54.2%**. Given the classic decoder (CSP+LDA) as a tool, the same stock model scores **62.5%** with no training, against **63.2%** for the decoder alone. The LLM adds control, not accuracy."
items.why_valuable: 用 144 试次与统计检验证明 LLM 直接解码在随机水平，价值在架构而非模型。

items.title_zh: EEGDash 一批 ingest 修复：CTF 残半试次、latin-1 重试与通道名不一致
items.title_en: EEGDash Ingestion Fixes: CTF Partial Trials, latin-1 Retry and Channel-Name Mismatches
bullets_zh: #516：对「**最后一个 trial 只写了一半的 meg4**」只读取完整 trial，避免把残段当有效数据；#517/#520：当 sidecar 记录数与文件头不一致时，正确取到通道名（iEEG、BrainVision/EEGLAB）。
#518：`.set` digest 解析器在遇到非 UTF-8 时改用 **latin-1 重试**，并排除已知问题数据集 ds005787。
这些都属于「格式不规范也要读对」的工程活：错一列通道名或多读半段数据，会让下游所有分析静默偏移。
bullets_en: #516 reads only whole trials from a meg4 whose last trial is only partially written; #517 and #520 resolve channel names when the sidecar count disagrees with the file header (iEEG, BrainVision/EEGLAB).
#518 retries the .set digest parser with latin-1 when the encoding is not UTF-8, and excludes the known problem dataset ds005787.
All are 'read it correctly even when the format is sloppy' work: one mislabelled channel column or a half trial silently shifts every downstream analysis.
items.brief: EEGDash 在 11-03 推进 9 次提交，几乎都是「格式不规范也要读对」：#516 对**最后一个 trial 只写了一半的 meg4**只读取完整 trial（残段当有效数据会让该被试的所有指标偏一点）；#517 与 #520 在 **sidecar 记录数与文件头不一致**时正确取到通道名（iEEG、BrainVision/EEGLAB）；#518 让 `.set` digest 解析器在非 UTF-8 时用 **latin-1 重试**，并排除已知问题数据集 ds005787。同批还有 Corpus tab 的 v0 文档（#519）。对做大规模入库的团队，这些修复的价值不在「多支持了某个格式」，而在**避免静默错位**——错一列通道名，后面所有空间分析都会跟着错。
items.brief_en: EEGDash made nine commits on Nov 3, nearly all about reading sloppy formats correctly: #516 reads only whole trials from a meg4 whose last trial is half-written; #517 and #520 resolve channel names when the sidecar count disagrees with the header; #518 retries the .set digest parser with latin-1. The value is preventing silent misalignment rather than adding formats.
items.raw_excerpt: PRs merged 2026-11-03: "fix(ctf): read only the whole trials of a meg4 that ends inside a trial (#516)" 15:22Z; "fix(ieeg): header channel names when the sidecar count differs (#517)" 15:31Z; "fix(ingest): latin-1 retry in the .set digest parser; exclude ds005787 (#518)" 16:43Z; "fix(ingest): BrainVision/EEGLAB header channel names when the sidecar co[unt differs] (#520)" 21:06Z.
items.why_valuable: 残半 trial 与通道名错位都会让下游分析静默偏移，属基础正确性修复。

items.title_zh: EEGEdu 修 256 Hz 滤波采样率、SSVEP/ERP 时序与 BLE 内存泄漏
items.title_en: EEGEdu Fixes the 256 Hz Filter Rate, SSVEP/ERP Timing and BLE Memory Leaks
bullets_zh: 浏览器端脑电教学/实验平台 EEGEdu 修复：**256 Hz 滤波采样率**（`samplingRate` 传错会让频带位置整体偏移）、滑块状态闭包、以及 **SSVEP/ERP 刺激时序**。
另修 **ConnectableObservable 内存泄漏**、**BLE 断连处理**与 KNN 识别逻辑——浏览器的 BLE + 实时渲染组合最容易积累这类问题。
对用网页做课堂演示或轻量实验的团队，时序与采样率错误直接决定「演示看起来对不对」。
bullets_en: The browser-based EEG teaching platform EEGEdu fixed the 256 Hz filter samplingRate (a wrong value shifts every band), slider state closures and SSVEP/ERP stimulus timing.
It also fixes ConnectableObservable memory leaks, BLE disconnect handling and KNN recognition logic — the browser BLE plus live-rendering combination accumulates such problems.
For classroom demos or light-weight experiments in the browser, timing and sampling-rate errors decide whether what you see is right.
items.brief: EEGEdu（浏览器里的交互式脑电教学/实验平台）在 11-03 连推 3 个提交，修的都是「看起来能跑但结果不对」的问题：**256 Hz 滤波的 `samplingRate` 传错**（频率轴整体偏移，SSVEP 目标频率会落到错误位置）、滑块状态闭包、以及 **SSVEP/ERP 刺激时序**。另两条更偏工程：**ConnectableObservable 内存泄漏**、**BLE 断连处理**与 KNN 识别逻辑——浏览器里「BLE 流 + 实时渲染」的组合最容易积累这类隐患，表现为跑十几分钟后越来越卡。对用网页做课堂演示或轻量实验的团队，这类修复直接决定演示是否可信；建议升级后对照已知 SSVEP 频率验证一次。
items.brief_en: EEGEdu, a browser-based EEG teaching and experiment platform, pushed three commits on Nov 3 fixing problems that run but mislead: the 256 Hz filter samplingRate (shifting the whole frequency axis), SSVEP/ERP stimulus timing, plus ConnectableObservable memory leaks, BLE disconnect handling and KNN logic. Browser BLE with live rendering accumulates such issues as progressive slowdown.
items.raw_excerpt: Commits 2026-11-03: "Fix 256 Hz filter samplingRate, slider state closures, SSVEP/ERP timing, …" (ad695d3ed4) 03:24Z; "Fix ConnectableObservable memory leaks, BLE disconnect handling, KNN rec[ognition]" (51fa47feaf) 03:52Z; "Fix GitHub Actions Firebase deploy workflow with --ignore-engines …" (8c0172ba1a) 04:06Z.
items.why_valuable: 采样率传错会让频率轴整体偏移、SSVEP 目标落错位置，教学演示直接失真。

items.title_zh: BlueMuse 修 Muse S Athena 启动失败（DATA_2 订阅报 ATT 253）
items.title_en: BlueMuse Fixes Muse S Athena Stream Start Failing With ATT 253 on DATA_2
bullets_zh: #87：修复 **Muse S Athena** 在订阅 `DATA_2` 特性时导致数据流启动失败的问题（蓝牙 ATT 错误码 **253**），让新一代 Muse 头环能在 Windows 上正常出流。
BlueMuse 是 Windows 上把 Muse 数据转发为 LSL/OSC 的常用工具，配合 OpenBCI GUI 或 Lab Streaming Layer 做实时实验。
对刚换 Athena 硬件的团队，这属于「不修就没数据」的阻塞项；建议升级后确认 EEG/PPG 两路都能起流。
bullets_en: #87 fixes Muse S Athena failing to start streaming when subscribing to the DATA_2 characteristic (Bluetooth ATT error 253), letting the newer Muse headset stream on Windows.
BlueMuse is the common Windows bridge that forwards Muse data to LSL/OSC for real-time experiments with OpenBCI GUI or Lab Streaming Layer.
For teams that just moved to Athena, this is a 'no fix, no data' blocker; confirm both EEG and PPG streams start after upgrading.
items.brief: BlueMuse 合并 #87：修 **Muse S Athena 在订阅 `DATA_2` 特性时数据流启动失败**的问题（蓝牙 **ATT 错误码 253**）。BlueMuse 是 Windows 上把 Muse 数据转发成 LSL/OSC 的常用桥接工具，很多实时实验（OpenBCI GUI、Lab Streaming Layer、PsychoPy 联动）都靠它取数；换到新一代 Athena 头环后如果起流失败，整套实验就卡在第一步。这类问题的排查成本很高——错误码在应用层看不出含义，往往要抓 BLE 日志才定位。对刚升级硬件的团队，这是「不修就没数据」的阻塞项；升级后请确认 EEG 与 PPG 两路都能正常出流。
items.brief_en: BlueMuse merged #87 fixing Muse S Athena failing to start streaming when subscribing to the DATA_2 characteristic (Bluetooth ATT error 253). BlueMuse bridges Muse data to LSL/OSC on Windows for real-time experiments, so a failed start blocks the whole pipeline, and the error code is opaque without BLE logs. Teams that just moved to Athena should confirm both EEG and PPG streams after upgrading.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #87 merged 2026-11-03T16:27Z: "Fix Muse S Athena stream start failing on DATA_2 subscribe (ATT 253)". Repo: kowalej/BlueMuse (Windows app to stream data from Muse EEG headsets).
items.why_valuable: Athena 起流失败会卡住整条实时实验链路，且错误码本身看不出含义。

items.title_zh: DR1M90G-BCI：安路 FPSoC 上的定点 MAC 运动想象推理核（中文）
items.title_en: DR1M90G-BCI: A Fixed-Point MAC Inference Core for Motor Imagery on an Anlogic FPSoC
bullets_zh: PL 侧实现挂在 **AXI-Lite** 上的**定点乘加（MAC）推理核**；PS 侧（ARM/Linux）把 **BCI Competition IV 2a** 的预处理特征逐 trial 送入完成**左右手二分类**，结果经 GPIO/UART 输出。
交付物完整：TD 工程、设备树、PS 程序与 MATLAB 算法脚本；作者明确边界——**当前是离线回放，不含在线脑电采集**。
对边缘 BCI（低功耗、确定性时延）是想看的路线：把分类器放 FPGA 逻辑里，而不是靠 CPU 跑 Python。
bullets_en: The PL side implements a fixed-point MAC inference core on AXI-Lite; the PS side (ARM/Linux) feeds preprocessed BCI Competition IV 2a features trial by trial for left/right hand classification, with results over GPIO/UART.
Deliverables include the TD project, device tree, PS program and MATLAB algorithm scripts, with an explicit boundary: this is offline replay without online EEG acquisition.
For edge BCI (low power, deterministic latency) this is the road worth watching: the classifier lives in FPGA logic rather than Python on a CPU.
items.brief: 新建仓库 DR1M90G-BCI（2026-11-03，中文）演示了一条**边缘 BCI** 路线：在安路（Anlogic）**DR1M90G FPSoC** 上，PL 侧做一个挂 **AXI-Lite** 的**定点 MAC 推理核**，PS 侧（ARM/Linux）把 **BCI Competition IV 2a** 的预处理特征逐 trial 送入，完成**左右手运动想象二分类**，结果经 GPIO/UART 输出。交付物相当完整：TD 工程、设备树、PS 程序与 MATLAB 算法脚本都在，并明确边界——**当前是离线回放，不含在线采集**。对关心「分类器放进 FPGA 逻辑、而不是在 CPU 上跑 Python」的低功耗/确定性时延场景，这是可读的参考实现；下一步的在线采集与量化精度影响仍需自行验证。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-11-03, DR1M90G-BCI demonstrates an edge BCI path on an Anlogic FPSoC: a fixed-point MAC inference core on AXI-Lite in the PL, with the PS feeding preprocessed BCI IV 2a features trial by trial for left/right motor imagery, results over GPIO/UART. The TD project, device tree and MATLAB scripts ship too, with an explicit boundary — offline replay only.
items.raw_excerpt: 「基于安路（Anlogic）DR1M90G FPSoC 的运动想象脑电（Motor-Imagery EEG）解码演示系统。PL 侧实现一个 AXI-Lite 挂接的定点乘加（MAC）推理核，PS 侧（ARM/Linux）将 BCI Competition IV 2a 数据集的预处理特征逐 trial 送入 PL 核完成二分类（左手 / 右手运动想象），并将结果通过 GPIO / UART 输出。」「当前为离线回放，不含在线脑电采集。」
items.why_valuable: 把 MI 分类器放进 FPSoC 逻辑并交付完整工程，且明确仅离线回放的边界。

items.title_zh: MNE-Python 提速通道映射与插值选取（autoreject 约 17s→14s）
items.title_en: MNE-Python Speeds Up Channel Mapping and Interpolation Picking (~17s to ~14s in autoreject)
bullets_zh: #14490：跳过不需要的**线圈几何计算**（已有插值数据时）、用 `set` 替代 `np.unique`、**向量化通道定位**，本地测试把 autoreject 从约 17 s 降到约 14 s。
#14489 同时提速「插值选取」路径——两条优化都指向同一类瓶颈：每次循环重复计算本可复用的几何/映射。
对批量跑 autoreject 或做大量插值的流水线，这类优化是线性叠加的收益。
bullets_en: #14490 skips coil geometry when it is not needed (interpolation data already computed), uses set instead of np.unique and vectorises channel location, cutting autoreject from about 17 s to 14 s locally.
#14489 speeds up interpolation picking alongside; both target the same bottleneck of recomputing reusable geometry and mappings inside loops.
For pipelines running autoreject at scale or interpolating heavily, such gains stack linearly.
items.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14490，做的是朴素的性能清理却收益明确：**跳过不需要的线圈几何计算**（插值数据已算好时就不该重算）、用 `set` 替代 `np.unique`、**向量化通道定位**——本地测试把 `autoreject` 从约 **17 s 降到约 14 s**。同日 #14489 还提速了「插值选取」路径。两条优化指向同一类瓶颈：在循环里重复计算本可复用的几何与映射，这在「按被试/按试次」批量处理的流水线里会被放大。对每天跑几十上百个数据集做自动剔除与插值的团队，这类收益是线性叠加的；建议升级后重跑一次基准，确认与旧版结果一致。
items.brief_en: MNE-Python merged #14490, a plain performance cleanup with clear payoff: skip coil geometry when interpolation data is already available, use set instead of np.unique and vectorise channel location, cutting autoreject from about 17 s to 14 s locally; #14489 speeds up interpolation picking too. Both target recomputing reusable geometry inside loops, which scales in per-subject pipelines.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #14490: "Speedup MEG and EEG channel mapping — A few simple changes to speed up `autoreject` a bit more (~17s to ~14s in local testing): 1. Skip coil geometry computation if it's not needed (like when interp data has already been computed) 2. Use `set` rather than `np.unique` 3. Vectorize channel location". Merged 2026-11-03T19:21Z. Same day: "Speed up interpolation picking (#14489)" 13:15Z.
items.why_valuable: 循环内重复几何计算被消除，批量 autoreject 流水线的收益线性叠加。

items.title_zh: autoreject 改用新版插值 API，并给出基准对比
items.title_en: autoreject Adopts the New Interpolation API, With a Benchmark Table
bullets_zh: #368：在可用时改用 MNE 新版插值 API（对应 MNE 侧「传入预计算插值数据」的能力），并附基准表：59 通道 EEG 从 **1.969 ± 0.084 s** 降到 **1.880 ± 0.026 s**。
作者把「信任测试来判断是否真的生效」写在 PR 里，同时给出实测数值——这种「测试 + 基准」双证据比单纯宣称提速可信。
对做自动坏段剔除与修复的流水线，插值是主要开销之一；升级可顺带获得小幅加速与更新的 MNE 兼容性。
bullets_en: #368 uses the newer MNE interpolation API when available (matching MNE's precomputed interpolation data work), with a benchmark table: 59-channel EEG drops from 1.969 ± 0.084 s to 1.880 ± 0.026 s.
The author notes they trust the tests to prove it works while also reporting measured numbers — a test-plus-benchmark pair is more credible than a speed claim alone.
For automatic artefact rejection and repair pipelines, interpolation is a major cost, so this brings a modest speed-up plus forward compatibility with MNE.
